questions.question: bk-435-lean-store-model also carries all the unmerged BK-389 (kernel code) and BK-432 (RFC-0021) commits. Which base should the PR target?

options.label: bk-432-key-resolution (Recommended)
options.description: Stacked PR. The diff shows only the BK-435 commits: the research doc, Alloy and Lean. It merges after BK-432, which merges after BK-389.

options.label: master
options.description: One PR carrying BK-389, BK-432 and BK-435 together, 46 commits including src/ kernel code. All three traces are gated, and the review covers everything.

options.label: store-model-axioms
options.description: An existing remote branch that also contains this stack. Choose this only if it is the integration branch you meant for BK-435.

questions.question: The GitHub MCP server isn't available in this session, and neither is gh. How should the PR get created?

options.label: I open it; you draft (Recommended)
options.description: I run the gates and write the title and body into ./tmp/pr-body.md. You paste them into GitHub's compare page and give me the PR number for the trace's review block.

options.label: I'll enable the MCP
options.description: You restart the session with the GitHub MCP server connected, and I run /pr end to end.
